entities.summary: Bhilali is a Bhil language spoken in India. it has two main varieties: Bhilali proper and Rathawi (Rathwi), which are largely mutually intelligible. A third variety, Parya Bhilali, is more distant but is still considered a dialect of the language. Bhilali is a modern language with roots in Asia.
